notes.title: Eriksholm: The Stolen Dream – Bug Fix Update
notes.notes: [p]Hi everyone! [/p][p]We’ve just released a patch for [i]Eriksholm: The Stolen Dream[/i] with a number of fixes and improvements based on your feedback. Thank you so much for playing and sharing your thoughts – it helps us make the game better for everyone!💛 [/p][p][/p][p]Here’s what’s included in the latest update: [/p][p][/p][p][b]Bug Fixes & Improvements[/b] [/p][list][*][p]Fixed a number of possible soft locks  [/p][/*][*][p]Fixed body placement when dragging someone  [/p][/*][*][p]Vent leaving logic on Mouse and Keyboard controls have been updated to have better pathfinding when clicking far away from the vent exit  [/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted chapter complete for the final level to trigger after last cutscene instead of after credits  [/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue with lingering animations not ending as intended [/p][/*][*][p]Several fixes and adjustments to improve visuals and fix glitches  [/p][/*][*][p]Optimizations to several areas to improve performance [/p][p][/p][/*][/list][p]As always, please keep your feedback coming and let us know if you encounter any issues. Thanks again for your support and for being part of the Eriksholm journey!  [/p][p][/p][p]– The River End Games & Nordcurrent Labs Teams [/p]

notes.title: The Journey Continues - Demo & Pricing Update
notes.notes:
[p]We’re incredibly grateful for all the love you’ve shown for Eriksholm over the past week. It means the world to us. Seeing so many of you connect with a game we’ve poured our hearts into is truly humbling — and the best part is, there’s still so much more waiting to be discovered. [/p][p][/p][p]If you haven’t had the chance to try the demo yet, we’ve got good news: it will remain available right up until the game’s full release, just four weeks from now. [/p][p][/p][p] While our journey as a team on this project is nearing its end, your journey into the world of Eriksholm has only just begun. We can’t wait for you to experience the full game soon.[/p][p][/p][p][b][i]Eriksholm: The Stolen Dream[/i][/b] will be priced at [b]39.99€ / 39.99$ / 33.50£[/b] on PC. [/p][p][/p][p]Stay tuned, and thank you again for being part of this with us. [/p][p]

— The Eriksholm Team[/p]

notes.title: Eriksholm: The Stolen Dream – The Release Date
notes.notes: [p]Mark your calendars – Eriksholm: The Stolen Dream arrives on [b]July 15[/b]! 🎉 [/p][p][/p][p]Get ready to explore a city gripped by oppression, sneak past watchful eyes, and help Hanna and her friends fight for hope in a world that’s lost it. [/p][p][/p][p]The wait is almost over. [/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="wFQHUcrJLys;full"][/previewyoutube][p] [/p][p]🎬 We've also shared an exclusive video featuring our Creative Director, Anders H., and more team members to talk about Eriksholm: The Stolen Dream during the [b]Future Games Show[/b] just now – catch up here: [dynamiclink href="https://www.youtube.com/live/3F3ivfA7-Vg"][/dynamiclink] ✨[/p][p][/p][p]----------------- [/p][p][b]Stay tuned and connected with us:[/b] [/p][list][*][p][b]Discord: [/b][url="https://discord.gg/KDRYpjjNJN"]https://discord.gg/KDRYpjjNJN[/url][/p][/*][*][p][b]NC Labs Twitter/X:[/b] [url="https://x.com/NordcurrentLabs"]https://x.com/NordcurrentLabs[/url][/p][/*][*][p][b]River End Games Twitter/X:[/b] [url="https://x.com/RiverEndGames"]https://x.com/RiverEndGames[/url][/p][/*][*][p][b]NC Labs Bsky:[/b] [url="https://bsky.app/profile/nordcurrentlabs.bsky.social"]https://bsky.app/profile/nordcurrentlabs.bsky.social[/url][/p][/*][*][p][b]River End Games Bsky: [/b][url="https://bsky.app/profile/riverendgames.bsky.social"]https://bsky.app/profile/riverendgames.bsky.social[/url][/p][/*][*][p][b]YouTube: [/b][dynamiclink href="https://www.youtube.com/@NordcurrentLabs"][/dynamiclink][/p][/*][*][p][b]Facebook:[/b] [url="https://www.facebook.com/NordcurrentLabs"]https://www.facebook.com/NordcurrentLabs[/url][/p][/*][*][p][b]Bilibili:[/b] [url="https://space.bilibili.com/3546844334394183"]https://space.bilibili.com/3546844334394183[/url][/p][/*][/list]
